goal: Make exhaustive dependency-aware decision-tree clarification the default interaction protocol in both imm-brainstorm and imm-planner without adding a Skill, mode, runtime state machine, or UI. Brainstorm owns product framing decisions and Planner owns execution-design decisions; both investigate repository facts themselves, ask the complete currently unblocked frontier in rounds with numbered recommendations, allow a zero-question fast path, retain only final decisions, and require an explicit final summary confirmation. Planner returns product-level uncertainty to Brainstorm. Preserve roundtable and adversarial as orthogonal lenses, preserve direct Planner entry for clear requests, repair the repository's pre-existing Managed Path bootstrap markers/headings, and lock source plus packaged contracts while removing the legacy fixed-question probing expectation.

acceptance.assertion: The source and packaged imm-brainstorm and imm-planner contracts define the default exhaustive decision-tree protocol, complete-frontier rounds, repository-fact self-resolution, phase-specific decision ownership, zero-question fast path, recommendation/bulk acceptance behavior, result-only persistence, explicit final confirmation, and Planner-to-Brainstorm return for product-level uncertainty; the root bootstrap files satisfy the Managed Path markers and Project Context heading; the prior Brainstorm probing contract no longer enforces fixed question counts or one-at-a-time dependent probing.
